reviews.text: I highly recommend this clinic. Dr. Roberto Bernal explains everything very clearly and is easy to understand. He speaks with such professionalism that you feel confident taking your babies there. It's an A+. The staff is wonderful; everyone is very kind, has a great personality, and provides excellent care. I highly recommend it if you're looking for good service.

They are the best in my opinion. I always take my dog ​​to them because I don't have to wait for hours, their price for each procedure is very fair, and their doctors and the entire team are excellent. I highly recommend them.
Highly recommended! First-class service, everyone is very attentive, fair prices, great customer service, good communication, excellent service. THANK YOU!

I found such a great place! I took my Yorkie for his yearly check-up last night. My experience was amazing!!!. The clinic is spotless, bright, and very well-maintained. The staff and the doctors are friendly, caring, and really attentive. I'm so lucky that this clinic is just around the corner from my house, so I can keep my dog healthy knowing the best people are nearby. Plus, they stay open late, which is really helpful. Congratulations to the owner; you have a wonderful staff.

All the doctors are very good and professional; they treat my dogs like humans!
I take my two Chihuahuas to them!
Rocky & Rambo! I'm even thinking about getting treated there myself! Hahaha.

Mady Gonzalez.
Thank you for taking care of my babies, Perrita and Gatica. You make the vet visit less traumatic for them and me with your kindness and affordable prices. Thank you 🙏
Highly recommended...excellent service, caring and very attentive doctors.

I love them so much! If you're looking for a vet you can trust completely, this has to be it! ☺️ I've been coming here for 3 years with my Ragnar (Yorkshire Terrier) and counting! The vet who has always treated him is Dr. Bernal, and he's amazing! Truly so patient, caring, and above all, very professional! But I have to mention that everyone there treats you well, from the lovely girl who greets you to the nurses on duty. They've all always been attentive and, above all, empathetic when treating our little guy! Are they located in Doral? Yes! We found them while living in Aventura (45 minutes to 1 hour away) and we wouldn't trade them for anything! Here's to continued success! 🤗🐶
Excelent service! Best veterinarians ever!! 100% recommended!

I had the best experience and services from Isa Animal Clinic, I recommend 100%, thank you for saving my baby Negrito❤️ & helping him get his surgery, to all the doctors and staff members who treated him with excellent care, compassion, and professionalism. I'm utmost grateful❤️

I can't say enough good things about Dr. Martinez and everyone over at Isa Animal Clinic. They have been our Vet of choice for years and have cared for our dog with compassion, love and transparent treatments. Great friendly staff, very clean facilities and absolutely fair prices.
A special service
Dr. Bernal and Dr. Rodriguez are the best. Always grateful.
Excellent place
I am eternally grateful to this clinic. 100% recommended.
I'm extremely happy with the service; the doctors are top-notch. If you want peace of mind when your dog is sick or has had an accident, this is the place to go.

I highly recommend Isa Animal Clinic, its doctors, and its entire staff. My 15-year-old dog is their patient, and our family is incredibly grateful for the care, kindness, and loving, compassionate service they provide. My Maltese, despite her condition, came through her surgery very well. We are forever grateful to Isa Animal Clinic.

The entire staff provided excellent service; they are wonderful people who treat you so well. Their care and love for the pets is incredible. I can't express how grateful I am to everyone. The doctor was amazing; she explained everything so well and was incredibly attentive. I recommend them 100%.

Endless gratitude to the incredible team at @isaanimalclinic
Our sweet Salem Marie, 7 years old — lovingly known as “Binky Butts” — was diagnosed with pyometra, a silent and life-threatening uterine infection. We had no idea how dangerous it could become, how quickly, or how close we were to losing her.

Because of your urgency, skill, and compassion, you saved her life. This experience changed us forever.

Please spay your cats. Pyometra is real, it’s deadly, and prevention truly saves lives.

Thank you for being angels when we needed them most. 💔➡️💛🐾 special thanks to @tania_torres_m  she Was knowledgeable, and immediately knew what was wrong with my cat. We need more like her in this world.

I have no words to thank the entire team at Isa Animal Clinic. What they did for Luna is priceless… Their empathy, their responsibility, their professionalism are a 10/10.

Don't hesitate to bring your furry children to this clinic; they will receive the best care. ❤️
I want to let you know that the service they provide is excellent, everything is impeccably clean, and Dr. Martinez is very professional. Aaron sends his regards.
Highly recommended. The Doctor Bernal and his assistants were professional all the time and took care of my dog!

I want to express my gratitude to Isa Animal Clinic for the excellent care they provided my family member during surgery. From the very first moment, the staff was very professional, kind, and understanding, which gave me great peace of mind during a difficult time.

They took the time to explain the entire procedure to me and showed a true commitment to my family member's well-being. Thanks to their dedication and care, the recovery was excellent.

I sincerely recommend this clinic for its compassion, professionalism, and the love with which they treat animals. 🐾💛

A month and a half ago, Rolo, one of my dogs, suddenly got sick with gastric issues and colitis (I'm not sure if that's the right word for the blood coming out of his anus). I took him in without an appointment, and they were incredibly kind, from the receptionist to the assistants and the doctor—the entire staff. The experience was very welcoming and friendly, and the place was spotless. They ran all the tests, which was a big plus, because they give you the results immediately. First, they examine your pet, then they give you a list of tests along with the estimate, and you can decide whether or not to approve all the procedures. Each test, procedure, supply, and treatment is itemized in the estimate. Today, Rolo is doing great! :) So, a huge thank you to the entire team at the clinic.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
I brought my puppy for his very first vet visit and had an amazing experience! From the moment we walked in, the front desk staff was so friendly and welcoming. The doctor and assistants were wonderful—so patient, gentle, and caring with my little one. They took the time to answer all my questions and made sure my puppy felt comfortable. I’m so happy to have found such a great team to care for him! Highly recommend! 🐶💙
My Chihuahua bite a toad and he was almost dying…. Thanks to the prompt response of all the clinic staff. My dog was saved…. 🙏🏻 …
Super nice place

Thank you..
Thank you..

The best of the best!
Always helpful and providing great customer service.

I can’t say enough about this animal clinic. Aside from being clean, courteous, and professional they go above and beyond!  They truly LOVE their patients and their humans.  They take their time with your pet and patiently explain and answer all your questions in detail. No waiting for appointments - just come in as needed, conveniently open until 10:00 PM on weekdays, and reasonably priced.  Having been a pet owner all my life I can truly say I’ve never encountered better veterinarians.   Thank you to all the veterinarian doctors and staff.
LILO loves you! 🐾

There aren't enough words to express how much we value Isa Animal Clinic. On August 16, 2024, we took our 12-year-old dog for a dental cleaning as she desperately needed it. Despite all the precautions that were taken by the clinic, our dog had an adverse reaction and became lethargic from the anesthesia. At the sight of this, everyone dropped what they were doing to not only stabilize our dog but also ensure that she survived. She did, and there is no doubt in my mind that it was thanks to the care she received.

Not only did they take care of our fur baby, they also treated us with an immense amount of empathy and love in what has been the scariest moment of our lives. They allowed us to be next to her during critical moments, comforted my daughter, and assured her that her dog would be okay. They treated our dog as if she was their own, and for that, they will always have our business and utmost respect.

Update: A week ago we were faced with the most difficult decision a dog parent can face. Putting our Maximus to sleep was beyond painful, but Dr. Martinez, alongside everyone else, was beyond supportive, professional, and made us feel as comfortable as possible. Their love for the pets they treat radiates in everything they do, even as they help them cross the rainbow bridge. My boy peacefully passed surrounded not just by our love, but by theirs as well.

Excellent care and unbeatable service. Their professionalism and the love they give to pets is evident. I am deeply grateful to the entire team, especially Tania and Dr. Martinez. They treated my princess with a love and dedication that exceeded my expectations. They instilled confidence in me from the moment we arrived, and I felt my little one was in the best hands. I will undoubtedly continue to trust them and will always recommend them. My gratitude is immense 🙏🏻

I am beyond grateful and blessed for the care my Rocky received from Dr. Martinez, and Roxana, the receptionist, who provided exceptional service and helped resolve everything quickly so my beautiful boy could have his surgery. I also want to thank the rest of the office team; please excuse me for not mentioning them by name, but we are immensely grateful to everyone. May God bless them all.

I want to take this moment to thank everyone who has a pet and knows what they mean to us. I arrived with my dog ​​in critical condition, and thanks to the magnificent, professional, and dedicated team, I can't thank them enough for everything they did for her. Words simply aren't enough to express my gratitude; if I could, I would give them a 10.

I had an emergency with my dog—he collapsed and was struggling to breathe. I was desperate and didn’t have the financial means for an expensive vet visit, so I searched on Google for an affordable clinic. That’s when I found Isa Animal Clinic, and it truly felt like a blessing.

From the moment I walked in, the staff was incredibly kind and attentive. The receptionist was welcoming, and the doctor showed deep knowledge and genuine compassion. He explained exactly what my dog needed and took care of him right away.

I was honest about my financial limitations and couldn’t afford everything my pet required. The doctor Roberto didn’t hesitate to help—he adjusted the cost and made sure my dog received the essential care. In a world where medical help often comes with a high price tag, it was heartwarming to find someone who puts the well-being of animals above all.

I highly recommend Isa Animal Clinic for both emergencies and routine checkups. They treat every patient with care and every owner with respect, no matter their situation. Thank you from the bottom of my heart.

I was recommended this clinic with excellent references, and I think they forgot to mention that from the moment you walk in until the doctors arrive, the service is absolutely outstanding. My dog ​​was very sick, and I had tried other clinics without any improvement. But coming to this clinic cured my dog's illness. He's eating very well now, and both he and I are happy again. I thank God and Isa's clinic and its excellent team. I recommend it 100% and give it 5 stars!
Excellent service, the best of the best, very professional and attentive. I recommend it 100,000 percent.

I took my cat Pepper for a dental cleaning and was extremely pleased with the care and loving treatment they provided. They kept me informed throughout the process, which gave me a great deal of peace of mind. If I could give them more stars, I would. Thank you so much for your service.
Amazing team , professional , clean and super friendly . They make you and your pet feel at home no matter the situation. Thank you again for going above and beyond and saving our Capri !
Excellent veterinarians, very professional and caring with the animals. They've treated my pets twice now, and I have the highest opinion of them and the place. God bless them.
THE BEST !!! ♥️

I am thrilled with the exceptional care my dog ​​received at ISA Animal Clinic for his teeth cleaning. The staff was warm, friendly, and genuinely attentive. The veterinarians explained everything clearly and handled my dog ​​with gentle compassion. The procedure was a success, and my dog ​​is now back to his happy, healthy self. Thank you for your outstanding service! I am so happy I chose you!

I am delighted with the exceptional care my dog ​​received at ISA Animal Clinic for his teeth cleaning. The staff was warm, friendly, and genuinely attentive. The veterinarians explained everything clearly and handled my dog ​​with gentle compassion. The procedure was a success, and my dog ​​is now back to his happy, healthy self. Thank you for your excellent service! I am so happy I chose you!

I didn't know where to go with my beloved Muso among so many places to visit for the first time in the US. From the moment I called, they welcomed us with open arms. During our visit, everyone was so kind and empathetic, from the receptionists to the medical staff. Thank you for your excellent care, affection, and solidarity. For us, you are 5 stars.
This place is amazing the staff is very professional and friendly

I can't say enough about Isa Animal Clinic. The doctors and staff are amazing! They saved my cat's life. I was very impressed with the service that I got. They truly love animals and did everything that they could to accommodate our particular needs. I am very grateful to them.

I stumbled upon this clinic by chance. The reason for my desperation led God to place these angels in my path. The medical care is top-notch. The doctors are incredibly warm and welcoming; from the moment you walk in, they make you feel right at home. They also do everything they can to help you. My cat couldn't be treated there because her surgery was considered suspicious, but Dr. Martinez was a huge help and referred me to a place she trusted, where my cat has now had her surgery. Thank you to all the staff there. Never change; our furry friends and families need more doctors like you.

For an emergency! We stopped there with our dog Abbby!! And we stayed!
The service was stellar!! From the reception staff to the doctors and the doctor's assistants! The owner is very kind and also works there!!
I highly recommend them!! Visit them!
The care and attention were amazing! We're so happy!
We'll definitely be going back!!
Definitely the best clinic with the best doctors. Our dog Coco got sick and we felt safe and well cared for!

My dog ​​Abby has been with me for 9 years. A few weeks ago, I took her to this clinic for an emergency because the one she'd been going to for years wouldn't admit her. I was disappointed, but God is great and powerful and put this clinic in my path, and I was truly delighted. The attention you receive from the moment you arrive makes you feel like you're with family. I recommend it 100%. I'm so grateful. I was taking her there and dropping her off all day for 5 days, and the care was always the same. Everyone who works at this clinic is incredibly attentive and caring, from the owner who was always there, to the receptionists, the assistants, and of course, the two doctors who managed to pull my dog ​​through. Everyone was so humane during the difficult time I was going through. You can see their dedication to what they do, and that's truly appreciated. And of course, after this experience, I will continue taking her to this clinic. Thank you! 🙏🙏🙏

This is truly the best clinic in Miami! My dog, Princesa, had surgery 14 days ago after arriving with a uterine infection. Thank God I took her to this clinic, thanks to the doctor and the nurse. They are wonderful people and incredibly professional. The doctor who performed the surgery was amazing! The care is much better than what my regular doctor provides. He called me every day to check on my dog's progress. The entire team is excellent and very kind, unlike other clinics that rip you off. They tell you the truth. The front desk staff are wonderful, especially Carmen, and the owners are great too. I am so grateful to them. I never leave reviews, but they truly deserve it. I'm not giving them more stars because I can't. Thank you, Isa Animal Clinic!

ISA Animal Clinic gives me the greatest peace of mind! I have two dogs and have had some experiences at other places, but when I arrived at this clinic, I felt the difference. They treated my puppy with so much love! The doctors are so sweet, and the staff guides you throughout the entire visit. I really liked the care plan they offer because it includes everything they need.
ISA ANIMAL CLINIC represents veterinary health at its HIGHEST LEVEL! On this last visit, I once again left feeling reassured, knowing that their health is well cared for and that they are committed to a holistic approach to caring for our beloved four-legged friends.
Thank you 🙏🏻 😍

I took my little boy Oliver Antonio ( my chihuahua )to Isa Animal Clinic for a deep dental cleaning, and it was a great experience. The staff is very friendly, and the vet explained everything clearly. Oliver received excellent care, and I got a complete report after the procedure. I highly recommend this clinic to all pets owners. Thank you for taking such good care of Oliver Antonio!
Excellent service! I'm very happy with my dog's surgery. The doctors were very good and professional. Highly recommended.

A few days ago I was very scared by my shepherd Mack's symptoms. I received excellent care from all the staff at Isa Animal Clinic, first from Dr. Alonso and his assistants, and then on the day of the surgery, Dr. Martinez was very kind. …
Excellent team and very professional, we were delighted
Excellent service! Recommended 100%
Dog Abby Isa Animal Clinic is a clinic with excellent service and very friendly staff.

I loved this clinic for my babies. It was highly recommended to me because of how good they are. I personally verified that the two veterinarians and three technicians I met, who treated my puppies with so much love, interest, and care, are …
